notes: Comments: mark an area with a rectangle (R) or a freehand outline (F) and type a comment; it shrinks to an icon you can hover to read
Leader comments (L): an arrow to the point with the text on the page
Four colours and revision clouds sized to the sheet
Comments list in the side panel, with show / hide (printing follows it)
Comments are standard PDF comments, so Acrobat, Bluebeam, Chrome and Edge show them too
